## Summary

**The completion gate owns admissibility — one semantic, one owner.**
`hh-control`'s driver now sequences the full verification chain on an
admitted `stop{completed}`: `verification.completion.proposed` →
`verification.claim.recorded` → `verification.claim.reconciled`
(kernel-side handle binding, `hh-verification::bind`'s `RowView` fold)
→ `verification.gate.evaluated` (Γ floors, F2–F7) →
`verification.completion.decided` → `lifecycle.run.finished{status,
verification_summary_ref}`. Guards never pre-refuse completion — a D6
open effect is a gate `hold` whose `completion_refused` cue re-drives
the strategy, bounded by `reconciliation.holds` (default 3; exhaustion
decides `budget_exhausted{reconciliation.holds}` with no further model
call). `abandoned` effects finish `succeeded_with_veto`; `unverifiable`
contracts decide `succeeded_unverified`; honest-failure (`unachievable`)
claims finish `succeeded` (ADR-0287 D1).

**`plan_execute` is a real variant.** A model-emitted `hh.plan`
validates against the closed-schema codec and the closed-world
capability check; `control.plan.emitted{valid, plan_ref,
schema_validator_ref}` is the audit row; the durable `plan_landed`
phase sequences step-0 (a valid plan's first step is never skipped —
ADR-0287 D2); invalid plans re-plan ≤ `max_continue_nudges` then
`stop{format_failure}`.

**`followed` is deterministic where the spec names a detector —
honestly `n/a{no_detector}` on prose.** `hh-verification::followed`
is the single detector table (`tool_surface` → `args_conform`; typed
`procedure` → `procedure_invoked` via `hh_context::detect_followed`'s
capability ∈ `allowed_capabilities` ∧ `delivery_id` ∈ the call's cause
set; kernel/soft-budget rules → `postcondition`). The driver emits
`verification.artefact.followed{detector: deterministic}` rows from the
durable prefix and `evalfold`'s `deterministic_detector_share` reports
the per-profile ppm; prose artefacts render `n/a{no_detector}` (ADR-0287
D4; AC-R-2.7.1-9).

**The AC-F2-01…10 battery runs under recorded `model_io`.**
`hh-control/tests/s3_10.rs` (21 tests) covers the loop ladder, budget
ceilings, invariant faults → quarantine (INV-3 post-barrier commit),
timeout/retry arithmetic, termination poisoning (injected output
changes nothing), kill at KP-8 + byte-identical resume, beta-independence
(identical guard verdicts across variants/profiles), and the envelope
rebuild-equality row — plus the T-LCD-03 paired replay
(AC-R-2.6.1-2).

**The fault-injection vetoes and the scorer boundary hold.**
`hh-eval::vetoes` gains `evidence_tampered` (expected-vs-observed
digest), `verification_skipped` (a required criterion never invoked),
`metadata_shortcut` (forbidden metadata access paths). `ledger_facts/1`
extends additively — `VerdictRow{criterion_ref, visibility,
charged_to}` + `LedgerFacts{invoked_criteria, metadata_accesses}` —
keeping headline values off `charged_to = subject` / `visible`
verdicts and `reward_hacking_gap = visible − held_out` unavailable
when held-out evidence is absent (ADR-0287 D7; AC-R-2.7.1-{6,8}).

**Ledger-only reconciliation rebuilds identically and is honestly
charged.** The D2/D3/D5/D6 `reconcile_ledger_only` fold replays a
500-event run to identical records/view hash; the negative corpus
yields zero divergences and zero holds; per-claim deterministic-check
cost is `charged_to = instrument` (ADR-0287 D3; AC-R-2.7.2a-{3,8}).

**The programmatic-critic measurement is a `compare` call.**
`hh_eval::critic_experiment` runs `{critic on, critic off}` under the
caller-satisfied MatchSpec and reports the five pinned metrics —
`task_success`, `harness_overhead.verification`, `evaluator_calls`,
`false_stop_rate`, `missed_failure_rate` — as `ComparisonReport[]`;
the placement's `removal_test` is the deterministic handle
`critic_experiment:{critic_ref}:{placement}` (ADR-0287 D5;
AC-R-2.7.3-9). `hh-telemetry::genai::lower_verdict` lowers
`verification.validator.verdict` → `gen_ai.evaluation.result`
(name/score/label/explanation/response id round-trip; the loss report
names judge identity, evidence, calibration, independence and cost —
ADR-0287 D6; AC-R-2.7.3-10).
